payload.description_html:
Title : Hoplostethus elongatus (Guenther). (modern name Optivus elongatus )

Creator: Griffin, L. T, artist

Date : [1920 - 1930]

Description : "Enlarged Figure of LONG ROUGHY Hoplostethus elongatus (Guenther). A brightly coloured fish with very roughened scales, not uncommon in shallow water with rocky bottom. Loc:- Kawau Island Hauraki Gulf." Typed text attached to drawing.

Format : Drawing

Media: Indian ink and wash 

Size:264 x 140 mm

Part of the Paintings and Drawings Collection

Citation: Auckland Museum ref. PD-1971-5-18. No known Copyright restrictions

For more details visit <a href="https://www.aucklandmuseum.com/collections-research/collections/record/am_library-paintinganddrawings-142" rel="noreferrer nofollow">www.aucklandmuseum.com/collections</a>
